name: Rosemary Focaccia
instructions: Whisk the yeast and sugar into the warm water and leave until frothy.
Mix into the flour and salt with the oil to a very wet, shaggy dough.
Fold the dough in the bowl four times at 30 minute intervals, then chill overnight.
Oil a deep tray, tip in the dough and let it come to room temperature for 2 hours.
Dimple all over with oiled fingertips and scatter with rosemary, garlic and sea salt.
Drizzle with the remaining oil and bake at 220C for 20 to 25 minutes until golden.
Slide onto a rack so the base stays crisp and eat warm.
